title: Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.14570v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Diffusion Models (LLDMs) are emerging as an alternative to autoregressive models, offering faster inference through higher parallelism. Similar to autoregressive LLMs, they remain prone to hallucinations, making reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) crucial for safe deployment. However, existing UQ methods are fundamentally misaligned with this new paradigm: they assume autoregressive factorization or use expensive repeated sampling, negating the efficiency of LLDMs. In this work, we present the first systematic study of UQ for LLDMs and propose lightweight, zero-shot uncertainty signals derived from the iterative denoising process, leveraging intermediate generations, token remasking dynamics, and denoising complexity. translated_title: 大语言扩散模型的不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 大语言扩散模型正在成为自回归模型的替代方案，通过更高的并行性提供更快的推理速度。与自回归大语言模型类似，它们仍然容易产生幻觉，这使得可靠的不确定性量化（UQ）对于安全部署至关重要。然而，现有的不确定性量化方法与这一新范式存在根本性的不匹配：它们假设自回归分解或使用代价高昂的重复采样，从而抵消了LLDMs的效率优势。在这项工作中，我们首次对LLDMs的不确定性量化进行了系统研究，并提出了从迭代去噪过程中导出的轻量级、零样本不确定性信号，利用中间生成结果、token重新掩码动态以及去噪复杂度。我们进一步通过将掩码扩散似然与基于轨迹的语义相异度相结合，将最先进的不确定性量化方法适配到LLDMs。我们证明了期望轨迹相异度可以下界……
tldr: 本文首次系统研究了大语言扩散模型（LLDMs）的不确定性量化问题，提出了从迭代去噪过程中提取的轻量级零样本不确定性信号，并通过结合掩码扩散似然与轨迹语义相异度，将先进的不确定性量化方法适配到LLDMs。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic study of uncertainty quantification for Large Language Diffusion Models, proposing lightweight zero-shot uncertainty signals derived from the iterative denoising process and adapting state-of-the-art UQ methods by combining masked diffusion likelihoods with trajectory-based semantic dissimilarity.
